    • findAll

      Iterable<T> findAll(Sort sort)
      Retrieves every document. Sorted listing first counts the documents; concurrent additions can cause the call to fail rather than return a partial result. Server-side sorting requires Meilisearch 1.16 or later.
      Specified by:
      findAll in interface PagingAndSortingRepository<T,ID>
      Parameters:
      sort - the sort order; attributes must be sortable in the index settings
      Returns:
      the documents in the requested order when sorted
